description: Use before creating, scheduling, running, repairing, slowing, retiring, or replacing MotherDuck Flights and before adding persistent MotherDuck analytics, so the next operation is the lowest-risk action that changes a live decision without disturbing active work.
evaluation_gates: No recommendation interrupts a leased active run, controller, shard, or external job
Every selected operation separates at least one live operational decision conflict
Terminal, superseded, repeated-failure, and repeated-NOOP fixtures receive the exact expected recommendation
Unknown or observationally indistinguishable cases remain UNKNOWN or IMPOSSIBLE instead of being mutated
Deterministic replay produces the same decision packet and semantic digest
Persistent schema or Dive changes require an explicit diff, rollback, and separate confirmation
inputs: MotherDuck definitions, schedules, versions, recent runs, and log fingerprints
External job states, leases, watermarks, costs, permissions, and provenance locations
name: motherduck-ops-governor
outputs: Lease-safe KEEP, BACKOFF, RETIRE, REPAIR, ON-DEMAND, ANALYTIC-ASSET, or BLOCKED recommendation
Minimum separating observation and counterfactual reversal condition
Provenance-preserving decision packet with deterministic digest
